cable.cable: Connfly DS1057-16A282R-30.5: separate 12 conductors, retain the red stripe; provisional length 120 mm including slack.
cable.assembly_current_limit: Dan specifies 1 A/contact. Board continuous current 0.5 A is an unmeasured design assumption. Qualify the cable, peak current and voltage drop; parallel contacts do not prove a multiplied assembly rating.
cable.route: Around the north screen edge; planned external cable loop physical Y <= -23 mm, design bend radius >= 5 mm. These provisional dimensions require assembly validation.
cable.header_mount_clearance_note: The headers were shifted left to preserve clearance to the north-east washers and arbitrarily rotated M3 hex standoffs. Physical center X is 70.5 mm.
cable.orientation_warning: After LOGIC rotates about X, both keyed headers face north but pin 1 is at opposite physical X. A correctly oriented half-twist of the ribbon or a custom 1:1 wire harness is necessary. The key alone does not prove 1:1 wiring.

sequence_bottom_to_top: RUICHI PCHSN-18 body directly on the POWER GND land
stack.qualification: Nominal dimension chain only. Measure the usable female thread depth and actual PCB, washer and stud dimensions. Confirm at least 3.0 mm engagement in upper joints, no bottoming and full lower nut engagement. Both metal washer faces must contact GND only.

sources.socket_catalogue_rating: 1A from previously checked Dan article195394; DS1016 manufacturer drawing does not state ampacity
